payload.title: Serializable seeded randomness
payload.author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.does: Repeatable random numbers, integer rolls and weighted choices with a portable 32-bit state. Use for loot, encounter tables and generated content. Runs locally with no service calls; not cryptographic.
exports.name: attach
exports.signature: attach(object, opts) → { next(), int(min,max), pick(entries), state, update(), dispose() }

payload.title: Clip animator
payload.author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.does: crossfades to the clip for state() each update
exports.name: attach

options.does: which state to show now, e.g. () => controller.state
options.name: state

options.does: which clip plays for each state
options.name: clips
options.default: { idle: Idle, walk: Walking, run: Running, jump: Jump }

payload.description: Plays a rigged model's animation clips by state, crossfading between them: wire it to a controller's state so the character idles, walks, runs and jumps. Clip names default to the expressive robot's.

payload.title: Serverless homestead co-op
payload.author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.does: Optional four-player Trystero rooms. Host validates intents and broadcasts signed snapshots; guests cannot write canonical state. Ephemeral identity works without browser storage. Host must stay online; no host migration or TURN service.
